title: NUnit
description: A mature testing framework with rich attributes and constraints for .NET.

data.text: `NUnit` is a mature, feature-rich testing framework inspired by JUnit. It provides a large set of attributes and constraint-based assertions that make tests expressive and readable.

data.title: Installation
data.content: Install NUnit and the test adapter.
data.code:
dotnet add package NUnit
dotnet add package NUnit3TestAdapter
dotnet add package Microsoft.NET.Test.Sdk

data.text: NUnit uses `[Test]` for test methods and `Assert.That` with constraints for expressive assertions.

data.title: Basic NUnit Test
data.content: A simple NUnit test for a string service.

data.text: NUnit constraints read like English sentences. You can combine constraints with `And` and `Or` for complex conditions.

data.title: Constraint Examples

terms.definition: An attribute that marks a class containing test methods.

data.title: Tip
data.text: NUnit supports parameterized tests with `[TestCase]` and `[TestCaseSource]` for data-driven testing without repeating test methods.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Assert.That with constraints produces readable assertions
Constraints can be combined with And and Or
TestCase and TestCaseSource support data-driven tests
data.takeaway: NUnit is a battle-tested framework with excellent constraint-based assertions.
